name: @khorsheed/dsh-gamedev
description: Mode bundle 游戏开发模式: the dsh-gamedev agent preset plus the game workbench it grants — build and play a small 2D web game with the agent — in one install. Thin meta package: a patch carrying the member's canonical rows and the mode's preset row, an npm dependency on the member, locale card metadata — no runtime code, no client half.

compat.notes: Pure composition: the bundle mounts the member's canonical rows plus the dsh-gamedev preset row and registers nothing of its own, so the floor is the member's own (0.2.0-rc.1 — game). Member behavior details live in the member's own dsh.compat.
